phase: EVRYN Phase 1.6 — External Error Analysis and Generalization
protocol: Zero-Leakage Split Isolation with Multi-Version Benchmark Reporting (Strict separation of Train, Dev, Locked Test, and External Generalization)

v1.description: Original benchmark manifest preserved without modification. PMC2816692 retains legacy Anthrax annotations.

v2.description: Authenticated real-paper annotations for PMC2816692 from genuine Salmonella enterica SrcA XML text and corrected title string for PMC2774163.

dominant_categories.cross_sentence_discourse: 28 FNs (58.3%) - Source and target entities do not co-occur in any single sentence
dominant_categories.direction_reversals: 24 FPs (22.7%) - Complementation syntax and terminal phenotype violations
dominant_categories.cross_page_direct_overprediction: 28 FPs (26.4%) - True cross-page gold relations predicted directly from summary clauses

experiments.name: Exp A: Passive Genetic Complementation Triggers ('was restored/rescued by/upon/in')
experiments.hypothesis: In genetic complementation experiments ('virulence was restored upon complementation with cheB2/salR'), standard forward SVO treats Virulence as Cause and Gene as Effect (reversal). Recognizing restored/rescued as passive indicators inverts argument assignment (Gene -> Virulence).
experiments.implementation: Added passive restore regex to PASSIVE_INDICATORS. Controlled by enable_passive_restore toggle.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Increases Dev Direct F1 from 0.5007 to 0.5076 by eliminating 1 spurious reversal FP without recall loss.

experiments.name: Exp B: Terminal Phenotypic Disease Endpoint Invariant
experiments.hypothesis: Terminal disease and host outcomes (Virulence, Pathogenicity, Host Survival, Protective Immunity, Mortality) are physiological endpoints, never molecular causes of bacterial genes. Rejecting assertions where a terminal phenotype causes a gene eliminates spurious reversed edges.
experiments.implementation: Enforced terminal phenotype direction filtering in PaperCausalExtractor.extract_assertions. Controlled by enable_terminal_phenotype_invariant toggle.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Substantially boosts precision on Train (0.280 -> 0.304, F1 0.3306 -> 0.3532) and Dev (0.397 -> 0.411, F1 0.5007 -> 0.5166) with zero True Positive loss.

experiments.name: Exp C: Microbiological Greek Morphology & Biofilm Canonicalization
experiments.hypothesis: Greek delta (Δ) denotes gene knockouts (ΔvicK -> VicK) and Greek sigma (σE, σ(E)) denotes alternative sigma factors (sigmaE). Resolving these and bidirectional equivalence between Biofilm and Biofilm Formation recovers missed molecular entities.
experiments.implementation: Stripped Greek Δ/delta- prefixes and normalized Greek σ/σ(X) to sigmaX in canonicalize. Resolved Biofilm <-> Biofilm Formation against known_entities. Controlled by enable_greek_morphology and enable_biofilm_canonicalization toggles.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Increases Train True Positives from 7 to 8 and raises Recall from 0.368 to 0.421.

experiments.name: Exp D: Combined Phase 1.6 Pipeline
experiments.hypothesis: Integrating passive complementation, terminal phenotype invariants, and Greek/biofilm morphological canonicalization delivers optimal precision and recall synergies.
experiments.implementation: Integrated all accepted improvements into extractor.py and normalizer.py.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Frozen as the final Phase 1.6 release.
